title: Hodge theory of secant varieties
summary: We study the local cohomology modules for the secant variety of lines of a smooth projective variety $Y$ and for higher secant varieties of smooth projective curves. We show that the local cohomological defect in the first case is related to the primitive cohomology of $Y$, and in the second case it is $0$.
